fields.statement: QA cycle 1: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 -run 'TestPropertyProjectionParity|TestParity|TestWritesThroughIndexMatchFold' ./internal/api (capped scope) ok in 15s; by hand with a HEAD build in a scratch repo, set/mv/retire on a node with disjoint landed heads and on a git-merged landed same-field conflict gave the same refusal and outputs as a base 556194e52 build.

QA cycle 1, HEAD build in a scratch repo with the default index: disjoint heads (two landed updates on statement and acceptance based on one create) show merged fields, version the last applied op, and new set/mv/retire name it as base and land; a draft's child under a parent retired by a later landed set is absent (show/set: not_found, check warns retired parent). ready, overlaps, milestones, ls and daemon status match the base build. Broken: rhiza inbox --json and health drop the accept item of a proposed change set whose leaf has a landed parent (1 of 3 listed; base lists 3); see finding f1.

QA cycle 1, HEAD build (index path, the CLI default): dry runs with pending entries (set cap-a --dry-run after a pending set and move) give base = the node's last landed op 01M7GV9GCCYS... on disjoint heads and merge the pending update; set --rebase moved a stale update onto the landed version and the change set landed; writes on a landed same-field conflict refuse with conflict exactly as the base build does.

QA cycle 1: test-only leaf; ran the scoped parity/index tests above in a capped scope, ok; confirmed by hand that the CLI's production Ctx uses index.DefaultPath (cmd/rhiza/ctx.go:116-119), the path these tests now take.
